name: avtoritet-tapper-rustore
description: Android wrapper for Авторитет 2.0 using Capacitor

scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && cap add android && node scripts/fix-android-manifest.mjs && node scripts/configure-android-ads.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android && node scripts/fix-android-manifest.mjs && node scripts/configure-android-ads.mjs
